note_ko: 구체적인 장소 팩(오빠 1026: 분위기·재질을 구체적으로 적어야 공간이 달라진다). 장소 디테일 기준(docs/장소팩_작성기준.md)에 따라 작성. {s}/{S}=she/She, {p}/{P}=her/Her, {o}=her, {lit}=빛이 닿는 의상 부분.
setting_en: an infinity pool on the terrace of a penthouse high above a city
feature_en: a long rectangle of dark-tiled pool water whose far edge is a clear glass wall above the city
a built-in lounge platform with thick white cushions beside a low glass screen
ground_en: pale polished limestone paving across the terrace
a wet darker band of stone along the pool edge
far_en: a skyline of towers spreading out far below the terrace
a wide river with a bridge of small lights in the distance

낮.sky_en: a clear pale blue sky above the towers
낮.light_en: bright sunlight comes from above and from the camera's left, falling across {p} face and shoulders
낮.shadow_en: short soft shadows lie on the limestone toward the camera's right
낮.desc_ko: 맑은 한낮, 위와 카메라 왼쪽에서 오는 밝은 햇빛

해질녘.sky_en: a wide sky running from deep blue overhead into orange and pink behind the towers

해질녘.shadow_en: long soft shadows stretch across the limestone toward the camera's left

밤.sky_en: a black night sky above a sea of city lights
